## Problem Statement

What problem does this solve? Why is this feature needed?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like to see implemented. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is this the best solution?

## Use Cases

Describe specific scenarios where this feature would be useful:

1. Use case 1
2. Use case 2
3. Use case 3

## Implementation Ideas

If you have technical ideas on how to implement this, share them here:

- Collector changes needed
- Config options required
- Output format changes
- Dependencies needed

- [ ] CPU Collector

## Additional Context

- Mockups, diagrams, or references to similar implementations
- Links to related issues or discussions
- Hardware requirements (if applicable)
- Performance considerations

## Priority

- [ ] Low (nice to have)
- [ ] Medium (would improve workflow)
- [ ] High (blocking use case)
